claims.claim: The toll in fresh clashes between Kuki and Naga armed groups in Kamjong, Ukhrul and Kangpokpi rose to nine, with killings on October 9 and 10, 2026.
claims.episode_span: The toll from fresh clashes between Kuki and Naga armed groups in Kamjong, Ukhrul and Kangpokpi has risen to nine
claims.source_title: Situation remains tense in violence-hit Manipur as toll rises to nine, CM calls for peace
claims.supporting_quote: Chief Minister Y. Khemchand Singh appealed for restraint after fresh clashes between Kuki and Naga armed groups killed nine people in Kamjong, Ukhrul and Kangpokpi districts

claims.claim: Chief Minister Y. Khemchand Singh condemned the killings and appealed for restraint and dialogue.
claims.episode_span: Chief Minister Y. Khemchand Singh said he condemned the killing of civilians
claims.source_title: Situation remains tense in violence-hit Manipur as toll rises to nine, CM calls for peace
claims.supporting_quote: I condemn the killing of innocent civilians and the violence... I have instructed the authorities concerned to take immediate and effective steps to control the situation

claims.claim: A 22-year-old mother of five was shot dead in Chassad village on the night of October 9, 2026, after which a 42-year-old man was killed and 10 houses torched.
claims.episode_span: the shooting, on the night of October 9 in Kuki-dominated Chassad village
claims.source_title: Situation remains tense in violence-hit Manipur as toll rises to nine, CM calls for peace
claims.supporting_quote: The fresh killings began after a 22-year-old woman, a mother of five children, was shot dead by unknown assailants in Kuki-dominated Chassad village, in Naga-majority Kamjong district, on October 9, 2026 night.

claims.claim: Officials said suspected militants killed M. Daimai, R. Gangmei and Ringkangmai in Tapon and Makui villages.
claims.episode_span: suspected militants on Saturday killed Naga village guards M. Daimai and R. Gangmei
claims.source_title: Situation remains tense in violence-hit Manipur as toll rises to nine, CM calls for peace
claims.supporting_quote: After the Chassad incident, two Naga village guards, M. Daimai and R. Gangmei, and another person identified as Ringkangmai, were killed when suspected militants attacked Tapon and Makui villages in Kangpokpi district on Saturday, officials said.

claims.claim: The Working Committee JTC Manipur claimed militants beheaded 52-year-old Ajinbou R. and demanded the head be returned.
claims.episode_span: claimed militants beheaded 52-year-old villager Ajinbou R.
claims.source_title: Situation remains tense in violence-hit Manipur as toll rises to nine, CM calls for peace
claims.supporting_quote: A Naga civil society organisation, the Working Committee JTC Manipur, also claimed that a 52-year-old villager, identified as Ajinbou R., was beheaded by militants, and demanded the return of the severed head for a dignified burial.

claims.claim: A court ordered the release of Abhijeet Dipke and two other Cockroach movement leaders ahead of a second day of Delhi protests.
claims.episode_span: A court has ordered the release of Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke and two other senior leaders
claims.source_title: ‘Cockroach’ party leader released as Delhi braces for second day of protests
claims.supporting_quote: Delhi braced for a second day of youth protests demanding the resignation of India’s election chief on Sunday, as a court ordered the release of the “cockroach” movement founder, Abhijeet Dipke, and two other senior leaders.

claims.claim: Reuters reported police detained more than 2,000 people on Saturday, and police said most were released Saturday night.
claims.episode_span: police detained more than 2,000 people on Saturday
claims.source_title: ‘Cockroach’ party leader released as Delhi braces for second day of protests
claims.supporting_quote: Reuters reported police detained more than 2,000 people to thwart Saturday’s protest.

claims.claim: UN human rights spokesperson Thameen Al-Kheetan urged respect for peaceful assembly, and India’s foreign ministry called the statement selective and an unwarranted interference.
claims.episode_span: India’s foreign ministry said the UN approach was selective
claims.source_title: ‘Cockroach’ party leader released as Delhi braces for second day of protests
claims.supporting_quote: India’s foreign ministry said the UN’s approach was “selective” and its statement constituted “an unwarranted interference in the internal affairs of India”.

claims.claim: The Bankwest Curtin Economics Centre estimates 456,000 Western Australians, including almost 99,000 children, are in poverty in 2026, 15.1 percent, up from 11.8 percent in 2021.
claims.episode_span: 456,000 Western Australians, including almost 99,000 children, are living in poverty, 15.1 per cent

claims.supporting_quote: The Bankwest Curtin Economics Centre’s 2026 Poverty Snapshot: The changing face of poverty in Western Australia found 15.1 per cent of Western Australians are now living in poverty, up from 11.8 per cent in 2021.

claims.supporting_quote: that’s one of the reasons why we’ve provided a billion dollars in this budget alone of cost-of-living relief for Western Australians.

claims.claim: Firefly cancelled all Subang–Seletar flights through Monday, October 12, because of haze.

claims.source_title: Malaysian low-cost carrier Firefly cancels all flights between Subang, Seletar airports due to haze
claims.supporting_quote: Malaysian low-cost carrier Firefly has cancelled all its scheduled flights between Sultan Abdul Aziz Shah Airport in Subang and Singapore’s Seletar Airport through Monday (Oct 12) as a “proactive measure” due to the haze situation in the region.
